model_annotations.Bulgarian: The provided bar chart illustrates the exploration density, denoted as ρ_E, for two categories—“Incorrect” and “Correct”—across different numbers of shots, ranging from 0 to 4, as indicated on the horizontal axis labeled “Number of Shots.” The vertical axis, labeled ρ_E, represents the exploration density and is scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.10, with gridlines at intervals of 0.05. The bars are grouped for each shot count, with the “Incorrect” category represented by blue bars with a dotted pattern and the “Correct” category by magenta bars with a diagonal hatching pattern, as specified in the legend. For each shot count, the “Incorrect” bar is positioned to the left of the “Correct” bar. The height of the bars indicates the value of ρ_E for that category at that shot count. At shot count 0, the “Incorrect” bar reaches approximately 0.06 and the “Correct” bar reaches approximately 0.11. At shot count 1, the “Incorrect” bar is approximately 0.06 and the “Correct” bar is approximately 0.11. At shot count 2, the “Incorrect” bar is approximately 0.03 and the “Correct” bar is approximately 0.10. At shot count 3, the “Incorrect” bar is approximately 0.025 and the “Correct” bar is approximately 0.10. At shot count 4, the “Incorrect” bar is approximately 0.025 and the “Correct” bar is approximately 0.07. The bars are arranged in ascending order of shot count along the horizontal axis, and no additional visual emphasis such as highlighting or color variation is applied to any specific bar.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart, titled “Exploration Density _E” from the paper “Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM,” illustrates the value of ρ_E (Exploration Density) for two categories—“Incorrect” (blue bars with dot pattern) and “Correct” (red bars with diagonal hatching)—across five discrete groups labeled by “Number of Shots” on the horizontal axis, which ranges from 0 to 4. The vertical axis, labeled ρ_E, is scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.10, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. For each “Number of Shots” value, there are two adjacent bars: the “Incorrect” bar is consistently shorter than the “Correct” bar. Specifically, at 0 shots, the “Incorrect” bar reaches approximately 0.06 and the “Correct” bar reaches approximately 0.11; at 1 shot, the “Incorrect” bar is at approximately 0.06 and the “Correct” bar is at approximately 0.11; at 2 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at approximately 0.03 and the “Correct” bar is at approximately 0.105; at 3 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at approximately 0.03 and the “Correct” bar is at approximately 0.105; and at 4 shots, the “Incorrect” bar is at approximately 0.03 and the “Correct” bar is at approximately 0.07. The bars are not sorted by height, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar. The legend in the top-left corner explicitly associates the blue patterned bars with “Incorrect” and the red hatched bars with “Correct.”
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Exploration Density _E (ρ_E) für verschiedene Anzahlen von Schüssen (Number of Shots), wobei für jede Anzahl von Schüssen zwei Balken dargestellt sind: ein blauer Balken mit Punktmuster, der „Incorrect“ repräsentiert, und ein rosa Balken mit Diagonalstrichen, der „Correct“ repräsentiert. Die horizontale Achse ist die „Number of Shots“ und zeigt die Werte 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4 in linearer Reihenfolge. Die vertikale Achse ist ρ_E und ist auf einem linearen Skalenbereich von 0.00 bis 0.10 skaliert, mit Tick-Markierungen in 0.05-Intervallen. Für jede Anzahl von Schüssen ist der „Correct“-Balken (rosa) deutlich höher als der „Incorrect“-Balken (blau). Der „Correct“-Balken bei 0 Schüssen erreicht etwa 0.11, bei 1 Schuss etwa 0.11, bei 2 Schüssen etwa 0.105, bei 3 Schüssen etwa 0.105 und bei 4 Schüssen etwa 0.07. Der „Incorrect“-Balken bei 0 Schüssen beträgt etwa 0.065, bei 1 Schuss etwa 0.06, bei 2 Schüssen etwa 0.03, bei 3 Schüssen etwa 0.03 und bei 4 Schüssen etwa 0.03. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern nach der Reihenfolge der „Number of Shots“ angeordnet. Es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung von Balken außer der Farb- und Musterunterscheidung, die durch die Legende gekennzeichnet ist.
